statement: Pinned Cemu HIDAPI accepts Wii Remote PIDs 0306 and 0330 but its A600FA/6 response path treats the built-in inactive suffix A4200005 as an inactive informational branch, whereas the external A6200005 suffix triggers MotionPlus activation at A600F0 and A600FE. Consequently an early 0306 unit returning the built-in constant may be discovered without Cemu activating its gyro through this path. Exact retail early-unit bytes and decoded gyro remain unknown; substituting an external constant would be an explicit compatibility shim, not proven fidelity.

applicability.revision: Cemu pinned native Wii HIDAPI; conditional early 0306 built-in inactive reply, no hardware measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. Cemu provider 275-380,925-950; Wii messages 36-59; HIDAPI PID filter 5-47. No Cemu early-Plus consumer run.
